select sent.DOCUMENT_ID msgDocId, TRIGGER_MSG_TYPE messageType, FOLLOW_UP_DOC_ID documentId, STATENO stateno, FNAME firstName, LNAME lastName, DOB dateOfBirth, PERSON_ADDRESS || ', ' || PERSON_CITY || ', ' || PERSON_STATE || ', ' || PERSON_ZIP address, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (PROV_LNAME, PROV_FNAME, NULL,NULL) as providerName, PROV_ADDRESS || ', ' || PROV_CITY || ', ' || PROV_STATE || ', ' || PROV_ZIP AS providerAddress, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') createDate, PROCESS_IND processInd from NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT sent, document_locator doc where
doc.document_id = sent.follow_up_doc_id and doc.document_type_code IN (SELECT * FROM TABLE(get_user_permissions(#{p_module_id}, #{p_worker_id}))) and
REVIEW_DATE is not null and nvl(REVIEW_UID, 'X') != '900'
PROCESS_IND = 'R' and LAFT_REVIEW_BY is null and TRIGGER_MSG_TYPE = '900 MS Incomp'
PROCESS_IND = 'R' and TRIGGER_MSG_TYPE = 'PRF PS Request'
PROCESS_IND = 'R' and TRIGGER_MSG_TYPE = '900 MS Incomp'
PROCESS_IND = 'R' and TRIGGER_MSG_TYPE = 'Possible AHI'
PROCESS_IND = 'R'
mapper.update: UPDATE NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT set PROCESS_IND='R_X', DELETE_IND = 'D', REVIEW_UID = #{p_worker_id}, REVIEW_DATE = SYSDATE where FOLLOW_UP_DOC_ID = #{p_trigger_doc_id} and PROCESS_IND = 'R'
UPDATE NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT set PROCESS_IND = 'Y', REVIEW_UID = #{p_worker_id}, REVIEW_DATE = SYSDATE where FOLLOW_UP_DOC_ID = #{p_trigger_doc_id} and PROCESS_IND = 'R'
mapper.insert: insert into PS_MESSAGE_COMMENTS(DOCUMENT_ID, COMMENTS, CREATE_ID, CREATE_DATE) values(#{p_documentId}, #{p_comments}, #{p_workerId}, sysdate)
mapper.update: UPDATE NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT SET LAFT_COMMENTS = #{p_comments}, LAFT_REASONS = #{p_reason}, LAFT_REVIEW_BY = #{p_workerId}, LAFT_REVIEW_DATE = SYSDATE where DOCUMENT_ID = #{p_documentId}
mapper.select: select comments.COMMENTS, case when comments.CREATE_ID is not null then comments_usr.LAST_NAME || ',' || comments_usr.FIRST_NAME end CREATE_ID, TO_CHAR(comments.CREATE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') CREATE_DATE FROM NYEHMS_USERS comments_usr, PS_MESSAGE_COMMENTS comments WHERE comments.document_id = #{dOCUMENT_ID} and comments.CREATE_ID=comments_usr.worker_Id union select laft_comments||'; '||laft_reasons as comments, case when LAFT_REVIEW_BY is not null then comments_usr.LAST_NAME || ',' || comments_usr.FIRST_NAME end CREATE_ID,TO_CHAR(s.LAFT_REVIEW_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM')as create_date from nyehms_std_message_sent s, nyehms_users comments_usr where document_id = #{dOCUMENT_ID} and s.LAFT_REVIEW_BY=comments_usr.worker_Id order by create_date
mapper.insert: insert into PS_MESSAGE_COMMENTS(DOCUMENT_ID, COMMENTS, CREATE_ID, CREATE_DATE) select document_id, #{p_comments}, #{p_worker_id}, sysdate from NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT where FOLLOW_UP_DOC_ID = #{p_trigger_doc_id} and PROCESS_IND = 'R'
mapper.select: WITH data AS ( select distinct CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_FIPS_CODE IN ('031', '041') THEN 'Essex and Hamilton' WHEN a.COUNTY_FIPS_CODE IN ('097', '123') THEN 'Schuyler and Yates' WHEN a.COUNTY_FIPS_CODE IN ('049', '089') THEN 'Lewis and St. Lawrence' ELSE Initcap(a.county_name) END COUNTY_NAME, ps_sort_order from coded_county a ORDER BY ps_sort_order ) SELECT county_name FROM data

WITH new900 AS ( SELECT Distinct a.stateno , a.person_county , Trunc(a.create_date) create_date , To_Char(Trunc(a.create_date, 'IW') - 1, 'MM/DD/YYYY')||' - '||To_Char(Trunc(a.create_date, 'IW') + 5, 'MM/DD/YYYY') create_week , Trim(To_Char(a.create_date, 'Month'))||' '||Extract(YEAR FROM a.create_date) create_month FROM nyehms_std_message_sent a JOIN coded_ps_msg_type c ON (a.trigger_msg_type = c.ps_msg_type) WHERE c.include_new900_count = 'Y' AND (
(Trunc(a.create_date) BETWEEN To_Date(#{p_fromDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND To_Date(#{p_toDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY'))
(Trunc(a.create_date) BETWEEN Trunc(To_Date(#{p_fromDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY'), 'IW') - 1 AND Trunc(To_Date(#{p_toDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY'), 'IW') + 5)
) ORDER BY create_date ), new900county AS ( SELECT Distinct a.stateno, CASE WHEN a.person_county IN ('031', '041') THEN 'Essex and Hamilton' WHEN a.person_county IN ('097', '123') THEN 'Schuyler and Yates' WHEN a.person_county IN ('049', '089') THEN 'Lewis and St. Lawrence' ELSE Initcap(b.county_name) END county, a.create_week, a.create_month, a.create_date FROM new900 a, coded_county b WHERE a.person_county = b.county_fips_code ORDER BY create_date ), final AS (
SELECT Distinct 'MONTHLY' report ,create_date , county , create_month metric , SUM(CASE WHEN stateno IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY county, create_month) group_count , SUM(CASE WHEN stateno IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY county) county_total , SUM(CASE WHEN stateno IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY create_month) metric_total FROM new900county
SELECT Distinct 'WEEKLY' report ,create_date , county , create_week metric , SUM(CASE WHEN stateno IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY county, create_week) group_count , SUM(CASE WHEN stateno IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY county) county_total , SUM(CASE WHEN stateno IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY create_week) metric_total FROM new900county
ORDER BY create_date ) SELECT report, county, metric, group_count, county_total, metric_total FROM final
